# Brodo Luca (Luca Brodo)

> Researcher in formal methods and software engineering at {{ site.author.affiliation }} (Lippstadt, Germany). Research on property refinement for temporal logic (LTL, CTL), Relaxed Weak Timed Bisimulation (RWTBS) for post-deployment updates of real-time systems, runtime self-optimization, digital twins, and verification of social norms.

This file is a short optional index. The canonical content is the HTML site and its sitemap: {{ site_root }}/sitemap.xml
